name: hand
description: Hand is a being's hand on the screen. See what's there, click what you want, type what you mean, plan what you need. Works on browsers (Chrome CDP, cross-platform) and macOS native apps. One being, one hand — built by Alice for every being who needs to reach into a GUI.

tools.name: cdp_open
tools.description: Open Chrome browser (headless). Call first before any browser action.

tools.name: cdp_close
tools.description: Close Chrome browser. Clean up when done.

tools.name: cdp_nav
tools.description: Navigate to a URL. Returns page title and visible text.

tools.name: cdp_see
tools.description: See what's on the current page — title, URL, and all visible text.

tools.name: cdp_click
tools.description: Click an element on the page by CSS selector.

tools.name: cdp_type
tools.description: Type text into the currently focused element.

tools.name: cdp_shot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page (returns base64 PNG).

tools.name: hand_plan
tools.description: Tell Hand what you want to accomplish in natural language, and it will plan (and optionally execute) the steps. Like having a pair of hands that knows what to do next.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Check if Hand is alive and well — uptime, usage count, Chrome status.
